Dedicated to the education of our patients, non-patients and communities through Chiropractic-based Vitalistic and Holistic Healthcare principles and laws. We strive to demystify the Chiropractic and Holistic healthcare field through the modern language of mysticism, science. We will also explore the philosophical tenets that allow Chiropractic to be a separate and distinct healthcare field from medicine while maintaining the status of Doctor both societally and under the laws of the land, with all the rights responsibilities therein.
Finally we will endeavor to present the art of Chiropractic and its many techniques through patient approved demonstrations of the Chiropractic Adjustment. 
This YouTube channel is intended as a patient resource and as a source for public information.
Remember, Healing happens in Alignment.
-Dr Reuben
